title: A Miami engineer, not an agency
p1: I'm Bryan Londres, an engineer from Miami. I'm the first engineer in my family and I graduated in Computer Science from FIU in 2026. I speak Spanish and English, so your site is written in both from the start, not translated afterward.
p2: At work I maintain production software that a company uses every day and run its cloud. I also build AI systems and test them so they don't say things they shouldn't. I bring the same care to your site: I build it, and you never have to explain anything to a middleman.
fact1_text: Team lead. I build with Claude, AI with safety tests, and software people use every day.
fact3_text: I helped Hispanic Computer Science students find their way in.
fact4_text: Spanish first, English with the same care.
